title: 2020 AMC 10B Problem 6
statement: Driving along a highway, Megan noticed that her odometer showed \(15951\) (miles). This number is a palindrome—it reads the same forward and backward. Then \(2\) hours later, the odometer displayed the next higher palindrome. What was her average speed, in miles per hour, during this \(2\)-hour period?

solutions.text:
A five-digit palindrome is determined by its first three digits. The first half of \(15951\) is \(159\); increasing this to \(160\) and reflecting the first two digits gives the next palindrome, \(16061.\)

Megan traveled \(16061-15951=110\) miles in \(2\) hours, so her average speed was \(\frac{110}{2}=55\) miles per hour. Thus, B is the correct answer.
hints: Find the next palindrome after \(15951\) before computing the speed
Increasing the middle digit forces a carry to the next palindrome
